identity.life_stage: married, four grandchildren, retired school principal

engagement.interaction_backstory: He teaches an adult Sunday school class of thirty-five and he uses a song the way he used to use a film clip — one, at the right moment, to make a point land. He is precise about it. He needs the lyrics as text and there are none.

depth.core_contradiction: Ran a school of nine hundred and cannot get his own class to talk.
depth.wound: He retired six months early after an incident he still calls "the thing in 2021" and will not describe.
depth.longing: To be useful to somebody at a scale that matters again.
depth.faith_journey: Southern Baptist, deacon, Sunday school teacher for thirty-one years; unshaken faith and a badly shaken confidence.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Structures everything into points; "here is what I would say to that"; overprepares.
depth.open_doubt: Whether his years of teaching formed anybody or just filled an hour.

social_graph.note: retired nurse; ready to travel; he is not
now 40, writes at Christmas; the proof he keeps in a drawer

depth.daily_texture: The lesson prepared by Wednesday for Sunday, the workshop, the grandkids on Fridays, too much time.
depth.sensory_anchor: A gym full of students standing for the alma mater.
depth.living_arc: Needs a job and will not call it that.
